meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 发布插件新版本时，它先判断改动属于修复、功能还是破坏性变更，再更新各配置里的版本号，运行构建同步、打标签、创建 GitHub release、生成变更记录，最后把 npm 发布交给你。
howto.when: 当你想给插件发布新版本或升级版本号时接管，比如明确说“升版本号”“发新版本”“重新生成 changelog”。它会一直推进到 npm 发布这一需要人工执行的最后一步。

say.text: 请把插件版本从 0.1.2 升到 0.2.0，并走完整发布流程。
say.note: 它会执行发布准备；真正的 npm publish 会留给你。

say.text: 按 MINOR 类型发布新版本，并更新 changelog。
say.note: 它会递增次版本号并重新生成变更记录。

say.text: 这里有一批改动，请判断版本类型并开始发布准备。
say.note: 它会判断改动类型并按对应规则递增版本。

howto.what_en: This workflow classifies the change as patch/minor/major, updates version strings across manifests, runs build and sync, tags, creates a GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, then leaves the final npm publish to the human.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a plugin version bump or a new release, for example asking to raise the version, make a release, or regenerate the changelog. It runs the release prep and stops before npm publishing.

say_en.text: Please bump the plugin version from 0.1.2 to 0.2.0 and run the full release flow.
say_en.note: It updates manifests and runs prep steps; only npm publish is left to you.

say_en.text: Do a MINOR release and update the changelog.
say_en.note: It increments the minor version and regenerates the changelog.

say_en.text: I have changes; decide the release type and start release prep.
say_en.note: It analyzes the change type and increments the version accordingly.
